EMBARGOED FOR RELEASE AT 8:30 A.M. EST, MONDAY, FEBRUARY 1, 2010

PERSONAL INCOME AND OUTLAYS: DECEMBER 2009

Personal consumption expenditures (PCE) increased $22.6 billion, or 0.2
percent. The PCE price index increased 0.1 percent. Excluding food and energy,
the PCE price index increased 0.1 percent.
